english_research_meaning: The historical May patch added the 805 reporting-form adapter and shared normative-ratio processing patterns with 135, including case/script normalization for codes.
defeater_or_limit: Presence of the form805 source file at the pinned tree supports code existence but does not validate official form schemas or every new ratio against official vintages.

english_research_meaning: The patch switched default bank labels to short uppercase normalized names and added thousands separators to exported Excel numerics without intending to change calculation formulas.
defeater_or_limit: A normalized bank display label is not an institution identity across perimeters or time; formatting separators do not prove numeric correctness.

english_research_meaning: A new FRG domain categorized provider filenames by family and period, including monthly, weekly, regional, card, mortgage, liabilities and Q variants.
defeater_or_limit: Filename recognition is weaker than verifying supplier provenance, parsed workbook schema and statistical comparability.

english_research_meaning: The patch applied historical regional schema filtering and rejected obsolete intra-month weekly revisions as candidates for latest family selection.
defeater_or_limit: An automatically chosen newest filename is not necessarily the newest official dataset edition and may hide a changed data vintage.

english_research_meaning: Two filename schemes were supported, with internal names winning same-period duplicates while unrelated/unrecognized files were promised to remain untouched.
defeater_or_limit: Known filename priority does not prove semantic duplicate equality or authorize modification/deletion of arbitrary neighbor files.

english_research_meaning: Cleanup could copy or rename selected files, remove old recognized entries and build a dated FRG ZIP bundle.
defeater_or_limit: Current direct FRG fault tests reproduced replacement-before-failed-copy/rename and archive-replacement hazards; an early summary claiming safe cleanup is not effect-atomicity proof.

english_research_meaning: The escrow domain proposed an end-to-end source link/download/cache/parse/long/pivot/export flow through FileStore with standalone XLSX and ZIP outputs.
defeater_or_limit: Presence of parsers and output modules does not verify downloaded CBR vintage, cache trust, or atomic artifact publication.

english_research_meaning: Escrow parsing tracked federal districts, Russian federal subjects and RF total rows with display order, indicator header registry and stable abbreviated Excel sheet names; introduced the residual-balance account-count indicator.
defeater_or_limit: A display row, regional aggregation and a similar header are not interchangeable observations; stable sheets cannot substitute for validated period/units/coverage.

english_research_meaning: Escrow parsing accommodated footnotes, parenthetical headings, rate-name variants, alternative RF total labels and old/intermediate/new workbook layouts.
defeater_or_limit: Tolerant header aliases can create a false match; accepting historic layouts requires dated and unit-tested source-to-field mapping.

english_research_meaning: Per-date absence of a known escrow indicator was treated as optional, with a retained sheet catalog and an explicit future region-registry mode reserved.
defeater_or_limit: A missing indicator is not a numeric zero, and a reserved region registry mode is not current authoritative territorial data.

english_research_meaning: A raw statistical-file collector combined a manually maintained URL registry, source-byte download and FileStore folder/ZIP storage paths.
defeater_or_limit: An HTTP 200 plus a saved file does not prove primary issuer authority, immutable source vintage or replay evidence.

english_research_meaning: The collector intended raw CBR files to remain untransformed, with provider/URL-derived names, collision uniquification and continued batch download after individual failures.
defeater_or_limit: A continued batch run does not imply all requested sources succeeded; unattempted sources and actual delivered bytes need separate accounting, especially after stop-on-error.
